_purpose: Single source of truth for which data each fit uses. Every script reads this file. All partitions below are RESERVED for the human baseline (Reddit, HN) or the agent baseline (Moltbook) and must never be reused for agent conditioning.

hn.note: BigQuery bigquery-public-data.hacker_news.full not configured in this environment (no credentials); using the brief's Hugging Face fallback.

moltbook_crawl.note: SQLite crawl, observation 2026-01-27..2026-02-09. Stores at most 100 comments per post (API limit; 10,728 posts affected per README). Contains the ~42 h comment outage starting 2026-02-01.

reddit.thread_window_applies_to: submission created_utc (root). All comments on in-window submissions are kept, including those after the window end, so reply delays are not truncated at 2021-12-31.

hn.thread_window_applies_to: story/poll time (root). All descendants kept regardless of their own time.

post_classes.link: story with non-empty url, not Ask/Show HN
post_classes.text_other: story without url, not Ask/Show HN (Tell HN, Launch HN, etc.)
post_classes.deleted_root: story/poll with deleted=true (no title/url, cannot be classified); reported as its own class from step 2 on

moltbook.thread_window_applies_to: post created_at (root). All comments on in-window posts are kept.
moltbook.gap_note: Periodicity-sensitive analyses must use contiguous segments. The 41.7 h gap is the 2026-02-01 commenting outage documented in the moltbook-crawl README; located empirically in step 1 (outputs/moltbook*/step1_coverage_gaps.csv).
moltbook.archive_role: SimulaMet archive is a cross-check only, and only for posts created 2026-02-08 onward (decision after step 1).
moltbook.segment_use: Steps 3 and 6 (timing, hazards, tails) use only the two contiguous segments. Step 2 structure uses the whole thread window.

truncation.thread_size: API-reported comment_count from the post table (complete for all posts).
truncation.shape_statistics: depth, fan-out by depth, reciprocity, OP return, bimodality use only completely stored threads (stored comments >= API-reported comment_count). Reddit and HN are reported both full-population and size-matched (threads with < 100 comments), side by side.
truncation.fits: stored size is right-censored at 100 in any fit that uses the trees.

spam_filter.source: De Marzo & Garcia (2026), Collective Behavior of AI Agents: the Case of Moltbook
spam_filter.rule: for posts with >= 5 stored comments, exclude the post if unique comment content / stored comments < 0.5 or unique comment authors / stored comments < 0.2
spam_filter.applies_to: all Moltbook analyses from step 2 on

holdout.stratify_by: calendar month (UTC) of root creation, per dataset (Reddit additionally per subreddit, HN additionally per post class)
holdout.method: within each stratum, threads are ranked by sha256('<seed>:<dataset>:<thread_id>') and the lowest round(0.2 * n) are assigned to validation; deterministic, no RNG state
holdout.assignment_files: data/processed/<dataset>/split.parquet (regenerable from this file; per-stratum counts in outputs/<dataset>/step1_split_counts.csv)

quantity_lists.rule: No quantity appears on both lists. Reply half-life is calibration only.

author_filters.bot_name_rule: case-insensitive regex (^bot[_-]|[_-]bot$|bot$) on Reddit author names: SENSITIVITY ONLY, never a filter
author_filters.top_active_definition: authors ranked by comment count within the dataset's in-window threads (per subreddit for Reddit); ties broken by name
author_filters.application: Filters are applied at comment level in analyses (comment excluded as a reply / parent candidate), not at tree-building time, so trees stay intact.
author_filters.primary_filter: explicit list in config/reddit_bot_authors.txt (AutoModerator, eliassjogreen/Reddit-Bot-List, known utility bots)

position_proxies.a: confidence-sort position from final score; look-ahead-affected (Reddit only)
position_proxies.b: early-thread arrival order, first 30 minutes; MAIN identification
position_proxies.c: contest-mode threads (order randomized); see outputs/reddit/step2_sort_census.csv before adding subreddits
position_proxies.d: suggested_sort = 'new' threads; second arrival-order identification (display order = reverse arrival)
position_proxies.hn: HN comment scores are hidden and its sort uses them, so HN position is latent: use only proxy (b) on HN

descriptive_scope.step2: Descriptive statistics are computed on the CALIBRATION split only; validation threads are left untouched for model validation.
